'''Qingbo Cask''' is a {{gear|5|Kit}}gear item.

{{Item description|Designed by Endfield after referencing wildland handcrafting techniques, and assembled by the AIC Factory. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.|Very economic equipment, created according to ancient scrolls and books found in Qingbo Stockade.
A small cask with an easy-to-clean filter core. The page about water purifiers was torn out of the ancient books for reasons unknown. This is why the missing cask component is replaced with a modern filter core.}}
